purpose: Which free, local GGUF should answer Chat on a machine of a given size. Work has its own catalog (app/config/coding-agent-models.json) because a coding agent needs tool calling and a 16K+ window; chat needs none of that, so the ranking here is about answer quality per gigabyte, risk of the quant, and whether the model is multilingual. It exists because 'chat = you pick' is not an answer when someone asks what to run.
budgetNote: Chat has no tool schemas and no agent prompt, so the window it needs is small (8K is generous). The fit rule is: weights + 2 GB of compute buffers + 1 GB of KV for an 8K window must fit inside the memory the machine can really address. Work is stricter and is computed from the KV arithmetic in coding-agent-models.cjs.
sources: app/config/coding-agent-models.json (the same models ranked for agent work)

models.name: Qwen3.6 27B (UD-IQ2_XXS)
models.notes: The most model that fits an 18 GB Mac at all: 27B of general reasoning in 9.4 GB. Quality at 2 bits is uneven sentence to sentence, so it is the pick for thinking, not for prose you would publish.

models.name: GLM-4.7-Flash 30B-A3B (IQ2_M)
models.notes: A mixture-of-experts body: 3B active per token, so it answers far faster than an 11 GB dense model would. Also tool-capable, which is why it appears in the coding catalog too.

models.name: Qwen3 4B (Q4_K_M)
models.notes: The safe everyday chat model: 2.5 GB, instant first token, multilingual including Thai, and it leaves the whole machine free for Work. Less depth than the 27B on hard questions.

models.name: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct (Q4_K_M)
models.notes: Steady English chat with the least repetition of anything this size; English-first, so it is the wrong pick for Thai conversation.

models.name: Qwen2.5-Coder 7B Instruct (Q4_K_M)
models.notes: A code model: fine for 'explain this function', flat for conversation. Already offered in the library, so it costs nothing to reuse if it is on disk.

models.name: Mistral Small 3.2 24B (Q4_K_M)
models.notes: The best chat quality in this list per gigabyte — and 14.4 GB of weights does not fit a 14.3 GB Metal budget. Listed so the boundary is visible: this is a 24 GB machine's chat model.
